account: Today I have followed my usual appointments, most recently tea with my neighbour, and must now return for my sixteen-thirty office appointment. There are hints of preparations for a gathering, but no confirmed explanation. The innkeeper requested a thirty-minute meeting tomorrow at eighteen in the great hall with his committee, described as concerning civic hospitality and community gatherings. I approved it and asked the secretary for names and an agenda; I have not yet received them. The secretary said no account figures, payments, council letters, or other actionable news had reached her. My neighbour saw the builder with the freight operator and baker at the bakery before noon. The baker mentioned twenty emeralds for baking, with grain supplied separately, but my neighbour did not know the customer or purpose. Earlier the builder was looking for the innkeeper and freight operator. I also noticed a lantern appear in the great hall this morning. These details could fit preparations for a community event, possibly connected with tomorrow's committee meeting, but that connection is only my suspicion. The bakery glow is not evidence of a celebration: my neighbour says the baker explained it as ordinary bread baking. I still do not know whether there is a celebration, who commissioned the baking, or whether anyone is intentionally keeping plans from me.
